hardware_profile: Windows 11, CPU-only (no representative GPU), live Docker containers (video-search-faz7-{pg,ch,qdrant}) reached directly from the dev venv with current-HEAD code

fixes.before: clickhouse.py/postgres.py/qdrant.py search_vectors() count queries omitted the candidate_ids restriction; candidate_count reported the unrestricted filtered corpus size even when a candidate_ids subset was supplied. In adaptive MRL, engine.py's diagnostics.setdefault('candidate_count', ...) never fired because stage-2's own (mis-scoped) key was always already present, so candidate_shortage/ann_filter_loss classification used stage-2's corpus-sized count instead of stage-1 data.
fixes.after: Count queries now include the same candidate_clause as the search query. New fields filtered_corpus_count/candidate_input_count/candidate_count_status/stage1_requested_candidate_count/stage1_returned_candidate_count/stage2_input_candidate_count/stage2_returned_count/final_returned_count expose the full breakdown. candidate_shortage/ann_filter_loss now key off stage1_returned_candidate_count (always known, never a conditional query).

fixes.before: engine.py._one_run() called embed_query(query, dimension) unconditionally, then, in adaptive mode, called embed_query(query, base_dim) again -- two independent calls into the embedding router. router.embed_query() had no caching in `real` mode, so this reran the full Qwen model forward pass twice per adaptive query.
fixes.after: router.py adds embed_query_raw() (mode-dispatch, no truncation) and embed_query_multi(text, dimensions) (one raw call, N truncate_and_normalize() derivations). engine.py's adaptive branch calls embed_query_multi() once for (dimension, base_dim) instead of two embed_query() calls.

evidence.note: GPU-timed before/after wall-clock savings for `real` mode could not be measured in this environment (no representative GPU, no verified pinned Qwen bundle -- see artifacts/baseline_contract/known_limitations.md); the call-count reduction is structural and applies regardless of hardware.

fixes.before: Every search_vectors() call ran an unconditional count() (no LIMIT) and an unconditional EXPLAIN indexes=1, regardless of whether the result was well-filled or whether any caller wanted that diagnostic -- 3 ClickHouse queries per search, 6 for adaptive mode.
fixes.after: count() only runs when the result is actually underfilled (len(rows) < top_k) or diagnose=true is requested; EXPLAIN only runs when explain=true is requested. Both are additive, default-false SearchRequest fields. plan_used_vector_index/candidate_count/filtered_corpus_count are honestly None (not measured) rather than a stale False/wrong-number when not computed, matching the existing 'olculmedi' (not measured) UI convention.

evidence.note: query-count reduction verified structurally (diagnostics fields prove count()/EXPLAIN did not run); a live p50/p95 latency comparison at scale belongs to the Sec.10/Sec.20 backend benchmark, run separately -- see artifacts/advanced_retrieval/backends/.

fixes.before: clickhouse.py client() opened a brand-new clickhouse_connect connection on every single call. POST /search is a sync `def` handler running in FastAPI's threadpool, so concurrency benchmarks measured connection-setup cost, not search cost.
fixes.after: Thread-local client caching (one Client per worker thread, created once, reused across that thread's calls) plus a _with_reconnect decorator that evicts and retries exactly once on transient connection errors (OperationalError/InterfaceError/ConnectionError/OSError/TimeoutError), leaving real query errors to propagate immediately.

fixes.plan_reference: Sec.2.5 (implicit, formalized in v2.1 Sec.4.4/7.5) / Sec.14 review item 1
fixes.before: adaptive_mrl.base_dim was constrained to {256,512} by its Pydantic Literal type only. Nothing checked base_dim against ENABLED_DIMENSIONS, nothing enforced base_dim < dimension, nothing enforced top_n >= top_k, and no explicit allow-list existed.
fixes.after: POST /search rejects (HTTP 400) any adaptive request whose base_dim is disabled, whose base_dim >= dimension, whose (base_dim, dimension) pair is outside the explicit ADAPTIVE_MRL_ALLOWED_PAIRS = {(256,512),(256,1024),(256,2048),(512,1024),(512,2048)}, or whose top_n < top_k.

GPU wall-clock savings from the single-embed fix could not be measured (no representative GPU in this environment).
